scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/duckdb packages/browser packages/react packages/spec packages/sql packages/duckdb-engine packages/js packages/grid && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/compile-react.mjs packages/grid
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/duckdb packages/browser packages/react packages/spec packages/sql packages/duckdb-engine packages/js packages/grid && tsc -p examples/playground --noEmit && tsc -p examples/bench --noEmit && tsc -p examples/files --noEmit && tsc -p site --noEmit
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w vastgrid-bench && playwright test
